transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As you know, we're planning to file our state application next month to expand our telehealth services. Before I give final approval to the application and its accompanying operating conditions, I need each of you — healthcare regulatory, corporate, insurance, and business — to review the current draft and flag any required changes. The draft currently describes the applicant as providing telehealth services through our existing corporate structure. Please take a look and let me know if anything needs to be revised before we move forward.
